name: Aldren Precision Tapered Chrome Trouser
description: Tailored-looking tapered trousers in heather grey synth-wool with a clean front crease and invisible side-seam zips from knee to ankle — allowing the lower leg to be opened flat for aug servicing without disturbing the overall silhouette. From across a room they look like office trousers. The material has just enough give at the hip and thigh to accommodate most sub-military aug frames.
functionality: Hidden knee-to-ankle side zips allow full lower-leg access for servicing without removing the trouser. Hip-flex panel accommodates aug joint range.
what_it_says: You keep your chrome out of sight and your appearance professional.
worn_by: anyone who needs to look clean-cut while managing augmentation
story_hooks: A mid-level corporate analyst wears these every day; nobody in the office knows she has prosthetic legs, and she'd like to keep it that way.
The hidden zips can be locked with a small pin — someone's pant was forced open while they were unconscious.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sharp, corporate-elegant silhouette that reads as high-end office wear from a distance. Tapered leg creates a streamlined look that flatters both baseline and augmented frames. The clean front crease and refined proportions signal Tier 1-2 status, but the hidden functionality suggests someone who actually needs it.
physical_description.fit: Tailored through hip and thigh with strategic stretch accommodation for augmentation frames. Tapers sharply from knee to ankle, creating a precise, almost military precision in the cut. Sits at the natural waist with a slightly high rise.
physical_description.primary_material: Heather grey synth-wool blend — premium grade with micro-elastane threads woven through for flex without visible distortion
physical_description.texture: Smooth, matte finish with subtle texture variation in the weave. Feels substantial and structured, almost crisp to the touch, with a slight sheen under direct light that reads as quality rather than cheap gloss
physical_description.color_scheme: Heather grey with barely-visible tonal pinstripe detailing. No visible hardware except at the hidden ankle zips where matte chrome accent fasteners peek through
physical_description.closures: Magnetic closure at waistband (corpo-standard). Invisible side-seam zips running from mid-knee to ankle on both legs — pull reveals ballistic mesh lining underneath
distinctive_features: Invisible side-seam zips for aug servicing access
Reinforced mesh lining on lower legs for durability when zips are frequently opened
Clean front crease pre-set into the material
Hip and thigh stretch panels integrated without visible seaming
Matte chrome micro-fasteners at ankle zip terminus
Interior tailor's mark: Aldren logo woven in subtle grey-on-grey
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury functional wear. Price point signals corpo wealth, but design philosophy signals someone who lives outside the clean office
physical_description.cultural_context: Corpo executive with augmentation infrastructure. Someone high enough in the hierarchy to wear tailored office wear, but practical enough to need field-serviceable aug access. Signals both corporate credentials and street-smart independence.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new, but develops subtle wear patterns at the ankle zips from repeated access. Front crease stays sharp through multiple wears due to material treatment. Upper garment remains office-fresh while lower legs show service marks

image_prompt: Closeup of heather grey tailored trouser leg on a tall androgynous model with visible chrome subdermal plating along the jawline, standing in a corporate high-rise office corner with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the GLMZ skyline at dusk. Golden-hour light catches the crisp front crease and subtle shine of the synth-wool. One foot lifted slightly to show the invisible ankle zip detail opening slightly, revealing matte chrome fastener. Dark moody office aesthetic, sharp shadows, cinematic lighting. --ar 2:3 --v 6
